name: USB Hardware
description: Structured USB inventory with protected hub-power and USB/IP limitations reported explicitly.

actions.unavailable_reason: The only controllable physical hub root also carries the active extroot and EC25 modem path. No independently switchable non-critical port can be validated on this topology.
The installed USB/IP client reports no usable VHCI controller, so there is no reviewed local virtual host-controller target for an attach workflow.

help_text: Inventory exposes summary/tree/verbose lsusb output with server-selected devices and bounded artifacts. Power remains unavailable because the only controllable physical root-hub port contains the appliance extroot hub and EC25 path; USB/IP attach remains unavailable because the installed client reports no usable VHCI controller.
